description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to decorate a ClaimExpense entity with additional data, such as setting claim requests by request ID, retrieving claim requests, and setting expense types. It also integrates services and traits for ORM, authentication, and date handling.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimExpense entity that provides additional methods to manipulate and retrieve related claim data.

methods.name: setClaimRequestByRequestId
methods.description: Associates a ClaimRequest with the ClaimExpense based on request ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimRequest entity based on request ID.

methods.name: getClaimExpense
methods.description: Returns the ClaimExpense entity being decorated.

methods.name: setExpenseTypeByExpenseTypeId
methods.description: Sets the expense type for the ClaimExpense based on expense type ID.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the claim expense formatted as 'Y-m-d'.
